title: 第五章 初遇悸动
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

餐桌上，烤盘锡纸上的牛肉滋滋冒油，边缘微微卷起，空气中弥漫着焦香的气息，陈舟拿着夹子翻面的动作还比较生疏，一块五花肉掉在了桌上，看得旁边的张晚柠噗嗤一笑。

陈舟侧着眼，不好意思地看了看坐在自己旁边的柠柠。

俩人四目相对，张晚柠笑颜如花的脸上没有一点不耐，反而伸出手，轻轻覆在了他拿夹子的那只手上，指尖轻触着他握夹子的手指。

“先这样，再这样哦！”

指尖相触的瞬间，陈舟只有一种感觉。

那棉花糖般的触感蔓延在陈舟手背上，酥酥麻麻的，他的手被柠柠的手带着，一块肉一块肉的翻烤着，连肉的焦香味都闻不见，仿佛失去了自我意识。

他下意识地侧着脸，偷偷瞄了一眼柠柠，欺霜赛雪的小脸漫着笑意，杏眼聚精会神地盯着烤盘。

此刻的他，脸有些微微发烫，心如同上了发条，砰砰直跳。

“好啦，好啦，开动咯！”

话音刚落，柠柠轻轻地松开了陈舟的手，一瞬间，他的手仿佛使不上劲一般，止不住地颤抖了一下，“哐当”一声，夹子掉在了地上。

陈舟连忙弯下腰，把地上的夹子捡了起来，刚直起腰，柠柠拿着筷子夹着蘸好了酱的牛肉放到了他碗里，眉眼弯弯，满脸调笑地看着他，凑到他耳边，跟之前在网上语音一样，夹起了嗓子。

“哥哥，怎么夹子都拿不稳了，是不是妹妹让你太紧张了。”

这声哥哥听的陈舟浑身一激灵，怎么刚刚还是清冷校花，现在怎么跟个小魔女一样嘛？

陈舟连忙把头收回去，没再理他，强压下心头的悸动，装出一副若无其事的样子，埋着头也不去看柠柠了，自顾自地吃了起来，此刻他感觉这些肉格外的好吃一些。

张晚柠坐在旁边，把筷子平放在碗上，侧着头静静地看着自己的舟舟跟个仓鼠一样，埋在小小的碗里吃着食物，脸上闪过一丝若有若无的笑意。

自己好坏呀，把这么纯情的舟舟第一次见面就调成这样。

啊，他不会觉得我这么会是因为谈过很多恋爱吧。

可自己只是喜欢看言情小说呀，小说上就是这么说的，和对方肢体接触会加好感度。

想到这些，张晚柠捋了捋脸前的头发，有些忐忑不安地问道。

“舟舟，我这样子，你会不会觉得我谈过很多恋爱，会不会觉得我是个坏女人，会不会不喜欢我呀”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the dining table, the beef on the tin foil of the baking pan was sizzling with oil, and the edges were slightly rolled up. The air was filled with the smell of burnt aroma. Chen Zhou's flipping movements with tongs were still relatively unfamiliar, and a piece of pork belly fell on the table. Zhang Wanning next to him laughed.

Chen Zhou looked sideways and looked at Ning Ning sitting next to him sheepishly.

The two people looked at each other, and Zhang Wanning's smiling face showed no sign of impatience. Instead, she stretched out her hand and gently covered his hand holding the clip, and her fingertips lightly touched his fingers holding the clip.

"First like this, then like this!"

The moment his fingertips touched, Chen Zhou had only one feeling.

The marshmallow-like touch spread on the back of Chen Zhou's hand, which was numb and numb. His hand was held by Ning Ning's hand, and the meat was roasted piece by piece. He couldn't even smell the burnt aroma of the meat, as if he had lost his self-awareness.

He subconsciously turned his face sideways and glanced at Ning Ning secretly. Jishuang Saixue's little face was filled with a smile, and his almond-shaped eyes were staring at the baking pan.

At this moment, his face was slightly hot, and his heart was beating like clockwork.

"Okay, okay, let's start!"

As soon as she finished speaking, Ning Ning gently let go of Chen Zhou's hand. For a moment, his hand seemed to be unable to exert its strength and trembled uncontrollably. With a "clang", the clip fell to the ground.

Chen Zhou quickly bent down and picked up the tongs on the ground. As soon as he straightened up, Ning Ning took the chopsticks and picked up the beef dipped in sauce and put it into his bowl. She looked at him with a crooked eyebrow and a face full of teasing. She leaned close to his ear and raised her voice just like before when she spoke online.

"Brother, why can't you hold the clip firmly? Is your sister making you too nervous?"

Chen Zhou's whole body trembled when he heard his brother's voice. How come he was a cool school beauty just now, and now he looks like a little witch?

Chen Zhou quickly took his head back and ignored him. He suppressed the throbbing in his heart and pretended to be nonchalant. He buried his head and stopped looking at Ning Ning. He just started eating by himself. At this moment, he felt that the meat was particularly delicious.

Zhang Wan Ning sat next to him, placing his chopsticks flat on the bowl, tilting his head to look at his Zhou Zhou, like a hamster, burying himself in a small bowl and eating food, with a faint smile flashing across his face.

How good or bad is he? He made such an innocent Zhouzhou look like this when they met for the first time.

Ah, he wouldn’t think that I am like this because I have been in a lot of relationships.

But I just like to read romance novels. This is what the novels say, physical contact with the other person will increase your liking.

Thinking of this, Zhang Wanning smoothed her hair in front of her face and asked a little uneasily.

"Zhouzhou, if I look like this, do you think I've been in a lot of relationships? Do you think I'm a bad woman? Do you think you don't like me?"
